question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

WITH ball_data AS (
  SELECT 
    bb.match_id,
    bb.innings_no,
    bb.over_id,
    bb.ball_id,
    bb.striker,
    bb.non_striker,
    COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
-- Get individual scores per player per match/innings (striker)
player_scores_st AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    striker as player_id,
    SUM(runs) as individual_score
  FROM ball_data
  WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, striker
),
-- Get individual scores per player per match/innings (non-striker)
player_scores_ns AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    non_striker as player_id,
    SUM(runs) as individual_score
  FROM ball_data
  WHERE non_striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, non_striker
),
combined_scores AS (
  SELECT * FROM player_scores_st
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM player_scores_ns
),
-- Get total runs per pair per match/innings (partnership runs)
pair_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    striker as player1,
    non_striker as player2,
    SUM(runs) as partnership_runs
  FROM ball_data
  WHERE striker IS NOT NULL AND non_striker IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, striker, non_striker
),
-- Get max partnership per match/innings with stable ordering
max_partnership AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    player1,
    player2,
    partnership_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC, player1 DESC, player2 DESC) as rn
  FROM pair_totals
),
-- Get individual scores for the top partnership players
top_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    mp.match_id,
    mp.innings_no,
    mp.player1,
    mp.player2,
    mp.partnership_runs,
    cs1.individual_score as score1,
    cs2.individual_score as score2
  FROM max_partnership mp
  JOIN combined_scores cs1 ON mp.match_id = cs1.match_id 
    AND mp.innings_no = cs1.innings_no 
    AND mp.player1 = cs1.player_id
  JOIN combined_scores cs2 ON mp.match_id = cs2.match_id 
    AND mp.innings_no = cs2.innings_no 
    AND mp.player2 = cs2.player_id
  WHERE mp.rn = 1
),
-- Order players by individual score DESC, then by player_id DESC
ordered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    CASE WHEN score1 >= score2 THEN player1 ELSE player2 END as player1,
    CASE WHEN score1 >= score2 THEN player2 ELSE player1 END as player2,
    score1,
    score2,
    partnership_runs
  FROM top_pairs
)
SELECT * FROM ordered_pairs
ORDER BY match_id, innings_no
LIMIT 20
